about: What each file-playback regression case checks. A case plays its oracle entry (parity-oracle.json filePlayback: fixture, calibration, settings) — or the fixture named here — through the app's file-playback path, then runs its checks. Check kinds: measurementComplete; materialPhaseComplete; capturedTaps / tapEntries (count); peaks — for each role, the identified peak (material: the selected fL / fC / fLC; guitar: the peak for the mode) against the oracle's 'expected' list, comparing 'fields'; perTapPeaks — each tap entry's peaks by role against the oracle's perTap rows; ringOut — the ring-out against the oracle's ringOutSec; phasesCaptured — how many of the material phases produced a spectrum; noiseFloorBetween — the noise-floor estimate, exclusive bounds. Tolerances are the oracle's: Swift, which mints the oracle, asserts at selfTolerances (zero), the others at the cross-edition tolerances.

REG-P1's session with noise raising its floor to -52 dBFS, above the tap threshold: an absolute detector captures nothing, the noise-floor-relative one all three phases; the floor must have converged (pinned near -100 would mean relative detection is off). Peak values are not compared — the noise moves them.
